handoff_payload.answer_text: Gross margin is not a useful metric for American Express because, as a financial-services company, its economics are driven by interest income/expense, credit-loss provisions, and operating expenses rather than cost of goods sold. In FY2022, revenue net of interest expense increased 27.7%—with non-interest revenue up 24.1% and net interest income up 27.7%—but provisions for credit losses increased by $3,601 million, while total expenses rose 24.1%, making these the more relevant drivers of profitability.
